note: Contract §17.3: the closed table the NPC ledger's stance moves by. Every number lives here; kernel/coc/npc.py reads it and writes no literal of its own. A social settlement moves the score by social[approach][level]; a pushed roll that failed adds pushed_failure_delta on top; any combat settled against this person sets the score to combat_target_score. The score is clamped to score_range and its word is the first level whose at_most it does not exceed. An approach or level absent from the table moves nothing: silence is zero, never a guess.
